items.claim: Header row dropped by `rowLines`, with a misleading warning
DOT reads and writes color names as CSS, but Graphviz uses X11
items.note: Bare names and `/x11/` names now read as X11 colors, including `grayN`/`greyN`. `/svg/` names still read as CSS, and DOT writes every color name except `transparent` as hex.

items.claim: DOT drops a cluster's dash in both directions
The DOT `node`/`edge` defaults leave out the theme's `penwidth` (and default dash)
DOT drops a node's size on an unplaced page
DOT `detect` refuses an HTML graph id

items.note: (same commit as the line above; both live in the header check)

items.claim: HTML DOT labels read with blank lines from the source's own line breaks, and table cells run together
Diagram JSON accepts a page with no `data`/`width`/`height`
items.note: This was a strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: the reader now refuses a page with no string id, no finite size, or no `data` object, and a graph page without `nodes`/`edges` lists.

items.claim: `WriteOptions.page` naming a missing page silently writes the first
items.note: Also a strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: `writtenPage` and `scenePageKinds` now throw a `RangeError` for an unknown page id, and an unset page still means the first. This changes behavior on purpose: an existing test that expected the first-page fallback for `'nowhere'` now expects the throw.

items.claim: `addTemplatePage` draws in the night theme whatever theme the scene names
items.note: It now defaults to the scene's own theme, and the README says so.

items.claim: `scenePageKinds` and `documentFromScene` disagree on a plot or sequence page
items.note: Both now use a new `pageRootsOf`: only outermost roots count, and a plot beats a sequence on the same page.

items.claim: `readShape` drops slot rows, image slots included
items.note: partly. Slots with an image or an id now read back in place with their height, width, id and image. A slot with neither can't be recovered here: it creates no scene node, and `@weasel-js/diagram`'s `bodyLayoutOf` records no row heights for any body with a slot row. Fixing that means recording slot bodies in the diagram package's relayout, which is another area, so I didn't file or change it. The changeset says this.

items.claim: A shape in both a container and a cluster loses its cluster membership with no warning
`sortedPage` sorts lanes, whose order matters, and never sorts clusters
items.note: (test-only helper; it isn't exported, so no changeset)
